children: Reed's amended its senior secured loan agreement with funds affiliated with Whitebox Advisors, with Cantor Fitzgerald serving as agent. The amendment sets a minimum liquidity requirement of $11 million and requires the company to receive at least $2.5 million in cash equity contributions by November 20, 2026; it also requires a $25,000 extension fee by that date. Reed's said a private placement has been delayed and is now expected to close by November 20, 2026, and that it has received $7.5 million in gross proceeds as of the report date.
